name: Sanctuary of the Ruler
summary:
A grand fantasy world composed of three major continents and eight nations.

There are lands where the Holy Sword is inherited, nations that revere spirits, a realm of Eastern-style samurai,
a land of deserts and dwarves, a region of snowy plains and elves…
And then, there is an empire whose ambition and military might threaten the balance of the world.

What begins as a conflict on a single continent eventually unfolds into an epic saga that spans the entire world.
